tvShow.name: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
tvShow.originalName: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
tvShow.overview: A century before the events of Game of Thrones, two unlikely heroes wandered Westeros: a young, naive but courageous knight, Ser Duncan the Tall, and his diminutive squire, Egg. Set in an age when the Targaryen line still holds the Iron Throne and the last dragon has not yet passed from living memory, great destinies, powerful foes, and dangerous exploits await these improbable and incomparable friends.

episodes.name: The Hedge Knight
episodes.overview: On his journey to the forthcoming tournament in Ashford, Dunk meets a clever young boy named Egg, who offers to be his squire.

episodes.name: Hard Salt Beef
episodes.overview: Dunk appeals to various lords in order to gain entrance into the tournament...but Egg advises him to hold onto his pride. When the Targaryens arrive at Ashford, Dunk seizes his moment with Prince Baelor.

episodes.name: The Squire
episodes.overview: After Egg attempts to train Dunk's uncooperative horse, Dunk teaches his new squire an important skill. As they take in the tourney's first full day of events, Dunk receives a proposition from the Ashford steward that could help secure his future.

episodes.name: Seven
episodes.overview: After landing himself in the Targaryens' crosshairs, Dunk exercises his right to request a trial by combat. But when Aerion insists on a trial of seven instead, Dunk is faced with the daunting task of finding six others to fight alongside him.

episodes.name: In the Name of the Mother
episodes.overview: Dunk's mettle is put to the test in the brutal trial of seven. Years earlier, Dunk finds himself drawn to the promise of a new future.

episodes.name: The Morrow
episodes.overview: As Ashford mourns a great loss, Dunk considers his next move...and whether to keep Egg as his squire.

reviews.author: tender_buttkiss
reviews.content: Just finished and now I'm kinda pissed that I'll most likely have to wait minimum two years before another season airs. Definitely will be worth the wait, but this season felt more like a teaser ofwhat the real show will be - if that makes any sense. The shortened episodes really made this a 4 episode mini series, and while I'm not mad about that cause it certainly delivered a heckuva good tale in that time frame, so hopefully future seasons will either have longer episodes or just more episodes in total cause I really really need some very engaging stories of heroism with our two protagonists!
